Definition: from G4486; something torn, i.e. a fragment (by implication and abstractly, a fall):--ruin.
BiblicalUsage: He that heareth and doeth not is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth, against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell, and the ruin of that house was great.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the ruin is great because the house looked finished until the water came.
